forecast.description: The forecast in force: the prospective test; absent while none is recorded for today.

last_year.description: Last calendar year: the retrospective test.

ledger_revision.description: The ledger revision the figures were read at (ENG-46).

on.description: The day the tests are read on: today.

reason.description: Why it is not assessed, or since when the organisation is registered.

registration.description: The registration in force, when registered.

share.description: The year so far as a percentage of the threshold, to one decimal (RND-PERCENT): for showing only; the test compares the exact amounts.

status.description: registered: nothing to test; liable: a test is met, so apply; near: the year so far reached the warning percentage; below: neither; not_assessed: an input is missing, which reason names.

threshold.description: The registration threshold of the sg-gst version in force: more than it makes a business liable.

warning_percent.description: The warning percentage, the setting gst.threshold_warning_percent.
